categories.main_business_segments: The Coca-Cola Company is a total beverage company operating through six primary segments: Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America; North America; Asia Pacific; Global Ventures; and Bottling Investments. The company owns or licenses and markets numerous beverage brands across categories including Trademark Coca-Cola, sparkling flavors, water, sports, coffee and tea, juice, value-added dairy and plant-based beverages, and emerging beverages. The company owns five of the world's top six nonalcoholic sparkling soft drink brands: Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, and Diet Coke/Coca-Cola Light.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company operates through two primary business models: concentrate operations and finished product operations. Concentrate operations involve manufacturing and selling beverage concentrates, syrups, and fountain syrups to authorized bottling partners who combine them with water and sweeteners to produce finished beverages. Finished product operations involve manufacturing and selling finished beverages directly to retailers, distributors, and wholesalers, as well as through Costa retail stores. The company uses rigorous quality management programs with stringent product safety and quality standards across manufacturing facilities in over 200 countries and territories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves consumers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide, with beverages accounting for 2.2 billion of the estimated 64 billion servings of all beverages consumed daily. Primary customers include independent bottling partners, retailers, distributors, wholesalers, and direct consumers through Costa retail stores. Major end markets include sparkling soft drinks (69 percent of unit case volume), water, sports drinks, coffee, tea, juice, and plant-based beverages. Key geographic markets include Mexico, China, Brazil, and India, which together account for 32 percent of worldwide unit case volume.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally across six geographic segments: Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America; North America; Asia Pacific; Global Ventures; and Bottling Investments. In 2022, the company derived $27.6 billion of net operating revenues from operations outside the United States, representing 83 percent of worldwide unit case volume. The company suspended operations in Russia in March 2022 due to the conflict with Ukraine. Major operating regions include Mexico, China, Brazil, India, and numerous European countries, with operations in all major developed and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at multiple points in the beverage supply chain. In concentrate operations, the company manufactures and sells concentrates and syrups to independent bottling partners (upstream/midstream position). In finished product operations, the company manufactures and distributes finished beverages directly to retailers and consumers (downstream position). The company also maintains consolidated bottling and distribution operations through its Bottling Investments segment. The company relies on a network of independent bottling partners, distributors, wholesalers, and retailers to make products available to consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: unlocking the potential of strong global, regional and scaled local brands; developing a robust innovation pipeline focusing on scalable initiatives; increasing consumer-centric marketing effectiveness and efficiency; winning in the marketplace with aligned data-driven revenue growth management; and embedding sustainability goals into operations. The company is focused on innovation in reduced-, low-, and no-calorie beverage options, sustainable packaging, digital transformation, e-commerce capabilities, and expanding into profitable beverage categories beyond traditional soft drinks.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through two primary models: concentrate operations (56 percent of net operating revenues) where the company sells concentrates, syrups, and fountain syrups to bottling partners; and finished product operations (44 percent of net operating revenues) where the company sells finished beverages to retailers, distributors, wholesalers, and directly to consumers through Costa retail stores. The company also generates revenue through promotional and marketing support programs, with $4.8 billion provided to bottlers and customers in 2022. Revenue is derived from sales in more than 200 countries and territories.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a highly competitive commercial beverage industry competing against numerous global and regional companies. Primary competitors include PepsiCo, Inc., Nestlé S.A., Keurig Dr Pepper Inc., Danone S.A., Suntory Beverage & Food Limited, Unilever, AB InBev, Kirin Holdings, Heineken N.V., Diageo, and Red Bull GmbH, as well as numerous regional and local companies and microbrands. The company's competitive strengths include leading brands with high consumer recognition and loyalty, a worldwide network of bottlers and distributors, sophisticated marketing capabilities, and a talented workforce. Competitive challenges include strong regional competitors, concentrated retail sectors, and rapid shifts in consumer shopping patterns.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The Coca-Cola Company is a large accelerated filer with significant financial scale. As of December 31, 2022, the company had approximately 82,500 employees (compared to 79,000 in 2021) and 4.3 billion shares outstanding. The aggregate market value of common equity held by non-affiliates was approximately $276.3 billion as of July 1, 2022. The company sold 32.7 billion unit cases in 2022 compared to 31.3 billion in 2021. The company maintains a strong capital structure with multiple debt instruments traded on the New York Stock Exchange and has historically paid quarterly dividends to shareholders.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Coca-Cola Company differentiates itself through its portfolio of iconic, globally recognized brands with high consumer loyalty and preference. The company emphasizes providing consumers with a wide variety of beverage options to meet diverse needs and lifestyles, including reduced-, low-, and no-calorie options. Key differentiators include: leading market positions in sparkling soft drinks, water, sports drinks, coffee, and tea categories; innovative and sustainable packaging solutions; transparent nutrition information and responsible marketing practices; a robust global distribution network; and commitment to sustainability goals including water stewardship, carbon reduction, and circular economy principles. The company positions itself as a total beverage company addressing evolving consumer preferences for health, wellness, and sustainability.
